record.field: Python: models, computed fields, constraints, views
Follow the membership fees of the shared gardens, and only rent the plots to the members who paid this year.

field.name: description
field.p: Gaart fir Jiddereen (“a garden for everyone”) runs shared gardens in Bonnevoie (Luxembourg) and in the Brill district (Esch-sur-Alzette): 20 members, 12 plots to rent. The treasurer follows the membership fees in a spreadsheet, and some plots are rented by members who did not pay this year.

div.p: Development challenge: Python and XML. Complete the module trivia_garden so that Odoo does the job: the TODOs of the code are numbered like the missions below, and give the details.
After a change of Python code, or a new file, field or record, update the modules (make update), then click Check: the tab Checker Report lists what is still missing.
The model garden.membership.fee and its fields: a member pays at most one fee per year, and the method action_mark_paid() marks fees as paid.
💡 In Odoo 20, an SQL constraint is declared with models.Constraint: _sql_constraints no longer exists.
The internal users can read, create, modify and delete the fees.
💡 Odoo 20 replaces ir.model.access.csv by ir.access.csv, with other columns: look at the lines already there.

div.h6: 3 · The views of the fees views/garden_membership_fee_views.xml views/menus.xml
div.p: A list view, a form view with the status in its header and a Mark as paid button only visible on the draft fees, an action and a menu.
💡 In Odoo 20, a list view is a <list> (no longer a <tree>), and attrs is replaced by invisible="…".
The fields of the members on the contacts, among which last_paid_year, the last year paid: stored, and always up to date.
A Membership page on the contact form, and a Not up to date filter for the members who did not pay the current year, without writing the year in the code.
Only a member who paid the fee of the current year can rent a plot, and a member rents one plot at most.
Load the fees of the members: data/garden_membership_fee_data.xml.

ul.li: A Fees smart button on the contact form, with the number of fees of the member.
A kanban view of the plots, grouped by site.
